ten: Thoat khi trung binh duong va RSI vuot nguong
mo_ta: Dong ca chuoi khi gia trung binh cua chuoi dang lai va RSI(4) M5 > 50 (GoldHunter), khong dat TP pip / USD.
vet: Tien thu khi dong khong co cum co dinh; lenh dong luc gia da qua gia trung binh.
ap_cheo: Thay TP co dinh bang 'thoat khi hoi nhe + RSI het qua ban': thu tren luoi AUDCAD, do chuoi ngan lai bao nhieu.
rui_ro: Chi bao ve lai tre: thoat muon, nha lai.
bang_chung_ghi_chu: chua co (the moi gieo, chua do)
